description: Connect your Savri or Besökskollen account to explore visitors, traffic sources, pages, goals and funnels for sites you can access. Connect Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools in the site dashboard to read search clicks, impressions, queries, pages and trends. Google uses the shared site connection; Bing uses your own connection for each site. Search reports are available from Basic. The OAuth connection needs no API key; the separate API-key/npm route requires API access from Growth. Reports preserve each provider’s date coverage and limits. Bing weekly Web reports differ from its daily traffic totals. These tools do not provide separate AI citation counts or link a search query to a person or order. Search reports are read-only; managing sites, goals, funnels or event properties requires write permission.

defaultPrompt: List my sites and compare visitors over the last 7 days.
Compare Google clicks over the last 7 final days, with actual coverage.
Show Bing’s latest weekly query report. State the report date and keep daily traffic separate.
